items.stem: A ball is dropped from a shelf. Which energy change mainly happens as it falls?

options.text: Gravitational potential energy transfers to kinetic energy
options.rationale: Correct: as it falls it loses height energy and gains movement energy.

options.text: Kinetic energy turns into height energy
options.rationale: That is what happens going up, not falling down.

options.text: Energy is created as it falls

options.rationale: There is a clear transfer from height to movement energy.

items.explanation: Correct: as it falls it loses height energy and gains movement energy.

items.stem: Which TWO things increase a moving trolley's kinetic energy? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: greater speed means more kinetic energy.
Correct: greater mass means more kinetic energy at the same speed.
Colour does not affect kinetic energy.
A stopped trolley has no kinetic energy.

items.explanation: Correct: greater speed means more kinetic energy.

items.stem: A toy car rolling on carpet slows down and stops. Where did its movement energy go?

options.text: It was transferred to heat and sound by friction
options.rationale: Correct: friction transfers the kinetic energy to the surroundings as heat and sound.
Energy is not destroyed, only transferred.
The car's mass does not change.
The energy spreads to the surroundings; it is conserved.
